title: Project Will: Observations #4–#6 and series synthesis — LLM villagers given books, bodies, and instincts
description: Full logs and analyses of the third installment of Project Will: 32 autonomous LLM-driven Minecraft villagers observed for 6 hours with no rules, rewards, assigned roles, or instructions to cooperate. Covers Observation #4 (time awareness, foresight, honest perception, a book for everyone), #5 (15 independently randomized body traits, starvation), #6 (instinct-driven agents with persistent self-assigned attitudes, promises, and child dependency), and four post-#6 verification runs (B-39 to B-42) that tested whether the absence of society was caused by system defects — including a whole-system audit that found 109 defects, 105 of which were fixed before a pre-registered 2-hour run. Includes structured event ledgers (gzipped JSONL), full speech timelines, full texts of all books, persona cards, death lists, a pre-release verification ledger re-deriving every claim from raw data, and a synthesis comparing all six observations. Main finding: individual inner life (records, plans, predictions, personalities) grew richer, but no mechanism for meshing with others — division of labor, exchange, two-sided agreements, collective response — emerged in this setting; villagers followed the designer-written persona cards but rarely followed peers' commands. Report in Japanese with an English summary.
